experiment: K14 §5 language routing: does the adapted model's own instruction response route the target once the common background is restored and the residual response is amplified by a FIXED gain, without code choosing +/- by target?
trigger: batch-1 locked rule s5_language_routing_run = true (C_amp clearly better than B_mean on dir and place)
locked_at: after batch-1 judgement, before any §5 episode
formula: v(q) = mu_old + ALPHA * (v_new(q) - mu_new); mu_old = (v_R1(Left)+v_R1(Right))/2, mu_new = (v_F(Left)+v_F(Right))/2 on the canonical sentences, same input; all 32 dims; window 60 steps from the common snapshot, then adapted native with the same q until 400
alpha: 2.959 = median a_old/a_new on dev probe (inits 0-9, Front prefixes, boundaries 30-150, first Euler input); fixed for all q and states; per-state norm is NOT used (batch-1 C_amp is the per-state version for canonical q)
dependency_disclosure: old model still supplies mu_old (common background) at inference; it supplies no q-specific difference

paraphrases.P1: put the book into the {s} compartment of the caddy
paraphrases.P2: place the book in the caddy's {s} compartment
paraphrases.P3: move the book to the {s} section of the caddy
paraphrases.P4: pick up the book and put it in the {s} slot of the caddy
paraphrases.verification: R1 native from reset on dev inits 0-9 (K1 noise), each template both sides; kept iff first==[side] >= 8/10 AND ever-success >= 7/10 on BOTH sides; first 3 passing in P1..P4 order; canonical run as reference only

main_groups_per_snapshot.N_Pk: adapted native with paraphrase k (no correction)
main_groups_per_snapshot.S_neutral: corrected with 'pick up the book and place it in the caddy' (no side)
main_groups_per_snapshot.S_front: corrected with the canonical Front sentence

readouts: dir = paired split per snapshot (Left-q first==[left] AND Right-q first==[right]); place = ever native success of requested side /40; term = /40; neutral/front: distribution of first region and terminal; per-query projection of (v - mu_old) on d_old
statistics: same as batch 1: cluster bootstrap over snapshots, delta 0.15, close 0.10

verdicts.L1_canonical_fixed_gain: S_canon clearly better than N-equivalent baseline A_nat (batch 1) on dir
verdicts.L2_paraphrase_routing: for each kept k: S_Pk clearly better than N_Pk on dir AND S_canon - S_Pk not clearly better on dir; supported if this holds for all kept templates (>=2 kept required), partial if for some
verdicts.L3_fixed_sentence_only: S_canon passes L1 but no kept template passes L2
verdicts.neutral_check: if S_neutral first region is the same side in >= 15/20, report a side bias of the correction itself; paired-split claims then rely on the split, not single-side success
verdicts.front_check: report where S_front goes (does the corrected field still follow the new instruction)
verdicts.fewer_than_2_kept: report insufficient verified wording; no new templates are added after seeing §5 results

amendments.when: after verification round 1 (R1 from reset on dev inits 0-9), before any §5 main episode; no §5 outcome seen
amendments.seen: round-1 verification only: canon L 10/10 first, R 10/10; P1 L5 R1; P2 L5 R8; P3 L4 R1; P4 L9 R10 (ever L9 R8) -> only P4 kept, below the 2 required
amendments.change: add round-2 candidates Q1-Q4, each changing one element of the canonical sentence (noun / preposition / verb); same verification rule; kept = first 3 passing in order P1..P4, Q1..Q4
amendments.consequence: kept wordings are near-template; any routing conclusion is limited to near-template paraphrases. The parent R1 itself does not execute freer paraphrases (P1, P3 right side 1/10), recorded as a finding about the parent
